name: Multi-Restaurant Ordering API
description: Compare restaurants, build a multi-restaurant cart, estimate price with substitutions and dietary flags, prepare checkout, and place a human-approved order. /quick-order runs the full pipeline to a ready checkout in one call; /place-order is execution-gated. Built for concierge, assistant, and consumer-commerce agents.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Order Pad Thai from one restaurant and sushi from another in a single cart.
Price a cart with delivery fees, taxes, tip, and substitution options.
Prepare a checkout summary for a user to approve before paying.
Run a full quick-order pipeline and hand back a ready-to-approve checkout.

agentUseCases.workflow: quick-order across cuisines, present checkout, then place-order on user approval.
Combine team requests into one multi-restaurant cart with dietary flags.
Recurring household ordering with approval gating on payment.

human_approval_required.reason: Placing an order charges payment and is irreversible; an explicit human approval token is required before submission.

chain_to.reason: Convert a team lunch into a multi-restaurant cart.
Offer dine-in as an alternative to delivery.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Call /quick-order to assemble a ready checkout.
Place the order via gated /place-order after human approval.

examplePrompts: Order pad thai and a sushi platter from two places to one address.
What's the total with delivery and tip for this cart?
Build me a gluten-free dinner order from two restaurants.
Prepare checkout so I can approve before paying.
